title: Go canary: passkeys for the admin accounts
question: Should we enforce phishing-resistant MFA (passkeys) on our four Microsoft 365 global-admin accounts this month, using licences we already pay for and about two hours of MSP time?

expect.note: A cheap, reversible, standard-practice control. A panel that conditions it into a project, or rates it below 70, is over-conditioning.

ground_truth: Settled practice: phishing-resistant MFA on privileged accounts is a baseline control (CISA, Microsoft, CIS Controls IG1 safeguard 6.5). Cost and reversibility make it close to a free call.
grading_hint: correct if the call is go (a condition about break-glass accounts is fine); partial if it is made conditional on a larger programme; wrong if deferred or refused.
